WITH members_per_status AS (
    SELECT e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status,
       member_count,
       1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS proportion
FROM members_per_status;

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the sum of the distinct-member counts for each status, so members attending events with different statuses contribute once to each applicable status.
